Import RNA-seq count data from multiple formats

rna_import.Rd

Imports and standardizes RNA-seq count matrices from common formats (HISAT2, STAR, featureCounts, tximport, or pre-cleaned matrices).

The function automatically detects gene identifiers (either as a column or row names), sample columns, and gene ID types. It performs basic validation and cleaning steps to ensure compatibility with downstream analysis.

When ENSEMBL identifiers are detected, version numbers are removed and duplicated IDs are collapsed by summation. Sample names can be optionally cleaned or manually renamed.

If metadata is provided, the function automatically detects the sample identifier column and validates its correspondence with the count matrix. Summary information (e.g., group sizes) is reported when available.

Usage

rna_import(
  project,
  count_matrix,
  metadata = NULL,
  format = c("clean", "hisat2", "star", "featureCounts", "tximport"),
  gene_col = NULL,
  group_col = NULL,
  gene_id_type = c("auto", "ENSEMBL", "SYMBOL", "ENTREZ"),
  organism = c("auto", "mouse", "human", "zebrafish"),
  rename_samples = NULL,
  clean_names = TRUE,
  strict = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  envir = parent.frame()
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object created by rna_project().

count_matrix

Data frame containing raw counts and gene identifiers.

metadata

Optional data frame with sample information. The sample column is automatically detected based on column names or matching values with the count matrix. If detection fails, the function will return an error (in strict mode).

format

Character. Input format: "clean", "hisat2", "star", "featureCounts", or "tximport".

gene_col

Optional character specifying the column containing gene identifiers. If NULL (default), the function will attempt to detect the gene column automatically. If no suitable column is found, row names will be used when possible.

group_col

Optional character specifying the column containing sample groups. If NULL (default).

gene_id_type

Character. Gene identifier type: "auto", "ENSEMBL", "SYMBOL", "ENTREZ". Default is "auto".

organism

Character. Organism name: "auto", "mouse", "human", or "zebrafish".

rename_samples

Optional character vector to rename sample columns. Must have the same length and order as the detected sample columns.

clean_names

Logical. If TRUE, automatically cleans sample names by removing file extensions and special characters.

strict

Logical. If TRUE, stops execution on validation errors.

save

Logical. Whether to store results in the active rna_project.

envir

Environment where to assign the object.

Value

An object of class "imp_data", containing:

  • data: Processed count matrix.

  • metadata: Metadata table (if provided).

  • n_genes: Number of genes.

  • n_samples: Number of samples.

  • gene_id_type: Detected or specified gene ID type.

  • organism: Organism used.

  • warnings: Validation warnings generated during import.

  • groups: (optional) Named list with group sizes if a Group column is present in metadata.

  • gene_annotation: Matrix with annotation of all possible genes of the provided data set.

  • warnings: Validation warnings generated during import, including automatic detection steps.

Details

This function serves as the entry point of the RNA-seq analysis workflow. It is designed to handle heterogeneous input formats with minimal user intervention by automatically detecting key structural components such as gene identifiers and sample labels.

The function does not perform normalization or transformation of counts.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Basic import with metadata
  rna_import(project = my_project,
             count_matrix = counts_df,
             metadata = meta_df)

# Import with metadata and specifying an organism
  rna_import(my_project,
             count_matrix = counts_df,
             metadata = meta_df,
             organism = "mouse")

# Import with a specific format
  rna_import(my_project,
             count_matrix = counts_df,
             metadata = meta_df,
             format = "star")
 } # }
